chapters.label: The corner
chapters.text: Belo Horizonte, 2014. The World Cup semi final, Brazil against Germany. Toni Kroos swings in a corner, and Thomas Müller slips away from his marker.

chapters.label: Nobody with him
chapters.text: Watch Müller. While everyone looks at the ball, he drifts to the back post. Nobody is with him! The ball drops, and he sweeps it in with one touch. Germany lead, one nil.

chapters.label: Get free
chapters.text: Want to be free like Müller? Move away from your marker before the ball comes. Find the empty space, and be ready to strike first time.
